methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched and adversarially verified for each vendor on 2026-06-15: sparkhire.com/pricing/ (all USD prices confirmed exactly, SOC 2 Type II stated on-page), willo.video/pricing returns HTTP 404 so willo.video/pricing-g2 (the live official Willo page publishing the same Growth/Scale USD tiers) was used and confirmed, hireflix.com/pricing (annual-billed USD prices confirmed; SOC 2 Type I confirmed via the live official blog post), jobma.com/pricing (quote-only confirmed), hirevue.com/pricing (quote-only; Essential/Premium are real package names with no published price; FedRAMP confirmed), vidcruiter.com/pricing/ (quote-only contact form; compliance from vidcruiter.com/security/), talview.com/en/pricing (quote-only unit-based; compliance badges on page), and Capterra (capterra.com/p/132345/RecRight/pricing/) for RecRight because recright.com pricing redirects to a contact form. RecRight prices are published in EUR only; monthlyUsd is left null rather than fabricating a USD conversion. Willo soc2 is left null because Willo's own security documentation lists only ISO 27001:2022 and GDPR — a third-party aggregator's 'SOC 2' claim was not corroborated by the vendor. myInterview was excluded: it has been absorbed into Radancy (acquisition announced Sept 2025) with no standalone public pricing page; aggregator price figures are inconsistent and unauthoritative. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

keyFeatures: AI resume review and AI interview summaries
